color.note: Brand colours are the four approved HEX values from the client questionnaire (primary: maroon + gold; secondary: navy + cream). Tokens marked 'derived' are shades/tints added only for states and text legibility.

tokens.name: brand-maroon
tokens.usage: APPROVED primary. Primary buttons, headings accents, active nav, links. Text on `surface-white` 12.45:1, on `surface-cream` 10.19:1.

tokens.name: brand-maroon-deep
tokens.usage: Derived. Hover/pressed state of `brand-maroon` fills and links.

tokens.name: brand-gold
tokens.usage: APPROVED primary. Decorative only on light grounds (rules, ornaments, icon strokes, price underline) — 2.4:1 on white, never body text there. As text/icon on `brand-navy` it passes (6.5:1).

tokens.name: brand-navy
tokens.usage: APPROVED secondary. Dark sections, footer, cookie banner ground. Also the default text colour (see `ink`).

tokens.name: brand-cream
tokens.usage: APPROVED secondary. Warm section ground and text on `brand-navy` (12.75:1).

tokens.name: surface-soft
tokens.usage: Derived tint between white and cream. Alternating section ground, image placeholders.

tokens.name: surface-cream
tokens.usage: Warm feature sections (about, services, CTA band).

tokens.name: surface-dark
tokens.usage: Footer, cookie banner, dark CTA band.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Derived. Secondary text, meta lines, captions on white (6.42:1), soft (5.96:1), cream (5.25:1).

tokens.name: accent-on-dark
tokens.usage: Headings accents, icons and links on `surface-dark` (6.5:1).

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: Derived. Decorative dividers and card outlines that carry no meaning.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Derived. Borders that carry meaning: outline buttons, filter chips, inputs (4.15:1 on white, 3.4:1 on cream).

tokens.name: whatsapp
tokens.usage: Derived from WhatsApp green, darkened so white text passes (5.41:1). WhatsApp buttons and the floating button only.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus outline on light grounds (≥12:1 on white and cream).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay over photography behind light text (video poster, mobile menu backdrop).

type.note: IBM Plex Sans Arabic + IBM Plex Sans (SIL OFL, Google Fonts). Arabic text is never letter-spaced. Sizes are desktop; see README for the mobile scale.

families.arabic: "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", "IBM Plex Sans", system-ui, sans-serif
families.latin: "IBM Plex Sans", "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.sample: الخيار الأول للتملك والاستثمار العقاري في تركيا
styles.usage: Hero headline only, once per page. Mobile: 34px / 48px.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Project card name, footer column titles.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: نساعد عملاءنا على اختيار العقار المناسب وفق احتياجاتهم وأهدافهم.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: خبرة واسعة في سوق إسطنبول العقاري.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Small kicker above section titles, in `brand-maroon`. Latin text in it may use letter-spacing 0.08em; Arabic never.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in buttons; tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile page gutter; card inner gaps.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Desktop gutter; gap between heading and content.

radius.note: Restrained radii for a conservative, premium tone.

breakpoint.note: Mobile-first min-width breakpoints. CSS custom properties do not work inside @media — copy the values.

tokens.name: header-height-compact
tokens.usage: Header after scrolling; logo swaps to the icon.
